_comment: Which thismoon mods Claude Code runs on this machine, applied by `agent-sync mods sync` on every ralph up. `marketplace` is the directory marketplace to register: the ralph sources cache of thismoon, which the [[recipe_sources]] stanza in config.toml pulls on every ralph up, so a merged mod change reaches this machine with that pull and loads in a new session or after /reload-plugins. Each entry under `mods` is one plugin that marketplace lists. `enabled` true (the default) installs and enables it at user scope, and runs `claude plugin update` while the install record's version differs from the plugin.json in its folder; false disables it when it is enabled and never installs it just to sit disabled. `installed` false retires it: uninstalled when it has an install record, even after the marketplace stops listing it. The marketplace directory must still be on disk; without it the whole file is skipped with a note. Leave `enabled` out beside `installed` false. `profiles` and `hosts` gate an entry to machines carrying one of those ralph profile tags (from ~/.config/ralph/config.local.toml) or hostnames (lowercased); a gated-off mod is left alone. A mod absent from this file is never touched, so retire with `installed` false, run ralph up on every machine, then delete the entry.

session-band._comment: on: a status line counting belt denials this session

humanizer-gate._comment: on: humanizer detection on markdown writes, PR bodies and commit messages

panel-policy._comment: off: installed and kept with its data, disabled until the review-model routing is wanted here

factory-band._comment: on for personal machines only: the factory skill runs there

loom-pane._comment: retired: uninstalled wherever it has an install record; delete this entry once every machine has synced
